重新思考集合论Rethinking set theory

汤姆·莱因斯特Tom Leinster

作为数学家，我们经常读到某个已知定理的漂亮新证明，欣赏其中不同的方法，却仍然依靠最初学到的方法来形成自己内在的理解。本文旨在彻底改变数学家思考［……］和教学的方式。

As mathematicians, we often read a nice new proof of a known theorem, enjoy the different approach, but continue to derive our internal understanding from the method we originally learned. This paper aims to change drastically the way mathematicians think […] and teach.

——谢尔登·阿克斯勒[1, Section 10]。

—Sheldon Axler [1, Section 10].

数学家几乎在每个工作日都会自信地操作集合。无论研究实数或复数的集合，还是向量空间、拓扑空间、群，以及其他许多以集合为基础的结构，我们都在这样做。这些底层的集合论操作已经熟练到近乎自动的程度，我们很少专门思考它们，也很少在集合操作中犯错。

Mathematicians manipulate sets with confidence almost every day of their working lives. We do so whenever we work with sets of real or complex numbers, or with vector spaces, topological spaces, groups, or any of the many other set-based structures. These underlying set-theoretic manipulations are so automatic that we seldom give them a thought, and it is rare that we make mistakes in what we do with sets.

然而，能准确说出通常所谓“那套”集合论公理的数学家，却寥寥无几。例如，没学过李代数公理就去研究李代数，是我们无法想象的；但我们许多人终其一生都不会去学习“那套”集合公理，而工作的准确性并未因此受损。这表明，我们每个人都或多或少在潜意识中掌握着一套可靠的操作原则，操作集合时便会使用它们。

However, very few mathematicians could accurately quote what are often referred to as ‘the’ axioms of set theory. We would not dream of working with, say, Lie algebras without first learning the axioms. Yet many of us will go our whole lives without learning ‘the’ axioms for sets, with no harm to the accuracy of our work. This suggests that we all carry around with us, more or less subconsciously, a reliable body of operating principles that we use when manipulating sets.

如果把其中一些原则写下来，并把它们作为集合的公理，会怎样呢？本文要传达的是：这完全做得到，而且方法简单实用。我们将介绍由F. 威廉·劳维尔提出的一套公理化方案[3, 4]，图1给出了非正式的概要。这些公理足以支持数学家对集合所做的几乎一切操作。因此，只要愿意，我们就可以完全放弃经典公理，改用这套公理。

What if we were to write down some of these principles and adopt them as our axioms for sets? The message of this article is that this can be done, in a simple, practical way. We describe an axiomatization due to F. William Lawvere [3, 4], informally summarized in Fig. 1. The axioms suffice for very nearly everything mathematicians ever do with sets. So we can, if we want, abandon the classical axioms entirely and use these instead.

为什么要重新思考？Why rethink?

传统的集合公理化体系称为带选择公理的策梅洛—弗兰克尔集合论（ZFC）。在这一公理基础上，人们取得了伟大的成就。然而，ZFC有一个重大缺陷：它使用“集合”一词的方式，与大多数数学家的用法相冲突。

The traditional axiomatization of sets is known as Zermelo–Fraenkel with Choice (ZFC). Great things have been achieved on this axiomatic basis. However, ZFC has one major flaw: its use of the word ‘set’ conflicts with how most mathematicians use it.

问题的根源是：在ZFC框架中，集合的元素总也都是集合。因此，给定集合XX，询问XX的元素的元素是什么，在ZFC中总是有意义的。而通常数学中一个典型的集合是ℝ\mathbb{R}。可如果随便拦住一位数学家，问“π\pi的元素是什么？”，对方很可能会以为听错了，或者问你在说什么，或者告诉你这个问题没有意义。若被迫回答，也许会说实数没有元素。然而，这又与ZFC对“集合”的用法相冲突：如果ℝ\mathbb{R}的所有元素都是集合，而且都没有元素，那么它们就全都是空集，于是所有实数都相等。

The root of the problem is that in the framework of ZFC, the elements of a set are always sets too. Thus, given a set XX, it always makes sense in ZFC to ask what the elements of the elements of XX are. Now, a typical set in ordinary mathematics is ℝ\mathbb{R}. But accost a mathematician at random and ask them ‘what are the elements of π\pi?’, and they will probably assume they misheard you, or ask you what you’re talking about, or else tell you that your question makes no sense. If forced to answer, they might reply that real numbers have no elements. But this too is in conflict with ZFC’s usage of ‘set’: if all elements of ℝ\mathbb{R} are sets, and they all have no elements, then they are all the empty set, from which it follows that all real numbers are equal.

ZFC的某些具体公理，同样与通常的数学用法格格不入。例如，其中一条说，每个非空集合XX都有某个元素xx，使x∩X=∅x\cap X=\emptyset。当XX是ℝ\mathbb{R}这样的通常集合时，很少有人会认为这句话有意义：说到底，π∩ℝ\pi\cap\mathbb{R}是什么？

Some of the actual axioms of ZFC are equally at odds with ordinary mathematical usage. For example, one states that every nonempty set XX has some element xx such that x∩X=∅x\cap X=\emptyset. When XX is an ordinary set such as ℝ\mathbb{R}, this is a statement that few would recognize as meaningful: what is π∩ℝ\pi\cap\mathbb{R}, after all?

我先回应一个可能针对上述批评提出的反对意见。传统的集合论方法不仅包含ZFC，还包含一整套把各种数学对象——实数、微分算子、随机变量、黎曼ζ函数等等——编码成集合的方法。这类似于计算机软件把不同类型的数据——文字、声音、图像等等——编码成二进制序列。在这两种情形下，连设计者自己也会承认，编码方法多少带有任意性。因此，有人可能反驳：本来就没有人声称，“π\pi的元素是什么？”这类问题会有有意义的答案。

I will anticipate an objection to these criticisms. The traditional approach to set theory involves not only ZFC, but also a collection of methods for encoding mathematical objects of many different types (real numbers, differential operators, random variables, the Riemann zeta function, …) as sets. This is similar to the way in which computer software encodes data of many types (text, sound, images, …) as binary sequences. In both cases, even the designers would agree that the encoding methods are somewhat arbitrary. So, one might object, no one is claiming that questions like ‘what are the elements of π\pi?’ have meaningful answers.

然而，知道不必过分认真地看待编码，并不能改变这些基本事实：在ZFC中，对一个集合询问“它的元素的元素是什么”，始终是合法的；在通常的数学实践中，却不是。为这两个用途使用同一个词“集合”，也许会造成误导。

However, our understanding that the encoding is not to be taken too seriously does not alter the bare facts: that in ZFC, it is always valid to ask of a set ‘what are the elements of its elements?’, and in ordinary mathematical practice, it is not. Perhaps it is misleading to use the same word, ‘set’, for both purposes.

三个误解Three misconceptions

下面给出的公理化方案，是劳维尔的“集合范畴初等理论”，最早于半个世纪前提出[3, 4]。这里的表述方式，完全不要求任何范畴论知识。

The axiomatization presented below is Lawvere’s Elementary Theory of the Category of Sets, first proposed half a century ago [3, 4]. Here it is phrased in a way that requires no knowledge of category theory whatsoever.

由于这套公理化方案源于范畴论，通常会产生三个误解。

Because of the categorical origins of this axiomatization, three misconceptions commonly arise.

第一个误解是：其根本动机在于用范畴论取代集合论。并非如此。这里描述的方法，不是集合论的竞争者；它就是集合论。

The first is that the underlying motive is to replace set theory with category theory. It is not. The approach described here is not a rival to set theory: it is set theory.

第二个误解是：这套公理化方案比其他方案，例如ZFC，需要更高的数学修养。这是错误的，但也可以理解。关于劳维尔公理的几乎全部研究，都是在拓扑斯理论内部进行的；那是一门优美而深刻的学科，却不易为外行所理解。人们一直知道，这些公理完全可以用初等方式来介绍；尽管已有一些作者强调这一点[3, 5, 6, 10, 11]，它却仍未得到应有的广泛认识。本文的目标，就是把这一点讲清楚。

The second is that this axiomatization demands more mathematical sophistication than others (such as ZFC). This is false but understandable. Almost all of the work on Lawvere’s axioms has taken place within topos theory: a beautiful and profound subject, but not one easily accessible to outsiders. It has always been known that the axioms could be presented in a completely elementary way, and although some authors have emphasized this [3, 5, 6, 10, 11], it is not as widely appreciated as it should be. This paper aims to make it plain.

第三个误解是：因为这套集合公理来自范畴论，而范畴的定义涉及一批对象和一批箭头，“一批”又可能近似于“集合”，所以这里存在循环——若要用范畴方式公理化集合，就必须事先知道集合是什么。然而，我们的方法虽然受到范畴思想启发，却不依赖范畴的一般定义。事实上，第2节的公理化表述中，连“范畴”这个词都没有出现过一次。

The third misconception is that because these axioms for sets come from category theory, and because the definition of category involves a collection of objects and a collection of arrows, and because ‘collection’ might mean something like ‘set’, there is a circularity: in order to axiomatize sets categorically, we must already know what a set is. But although our approach is categorically inspired, it does not depend on having a general definition of category. Indeed, our axiomatization (Section 2) does not contain a single instance of the word ‘category’.

换句话说，这里的循环性问题并不比ZFC更多。非正式地说，ZFC讲的是：“有一些称为集合的东西，集合上有一个称为隶属关系的二元关系，并且有一些公理成立。”我们则说：“有一些称为集合的东西，还有一些称为函数的东西；有一种称为函数复合的运算，并且有一些公理成立。”两种情形都不要求这些“东西”构成一个集合——不管这句话究竟意味着什么。用逻辑学术语来说，两套公理化体系都只是一阶理论。

Put another way, circularity is no more a problem here than in ZFC. Informally, ZFC says ‘there are some things called sets, there is a binary relation on sets called membership, and some axioms hold’. We will say ‘there are some things called sets and some things called functions, there is an operation called composition of functions, and some axioms hold’. In neither case are the ‘things’ required to form a set (whatever that would mean). In logical terminology, both axiomatizations are simply first-order theories.

序曲：把元素看作函数Prelude: elements as functions

数学工作者的词汇包括集合、函数、元素、子集、等价关系等术语。任何集合公理化方案，都会从中选取一些概念作为原始概念，再导出其他概念。传统的选择是集合与元素；我们采用集合与函数。

The working mathematician’s vocabulary includes terms such as set, function, element, subset, and equivalence relation. Any axiomatization of sets will choose some of these concepts as primitive and derive the others. The traditional choice is sets and elements. We use sets and functions.

正式的公理化表述在第2节。不过，先考察其中一个方面会很有帮助：如何从函数概念导出元素概念。

The formal axiomatization is presented in Section 2. However, it will be helpful to consider one aspect in advance: how to derive the concept of element from the concept of function.

暂且假定，我们已经在不知道元素是什么的情况下，找到了刻画单元素集的方法；下面将会这样做。固定一个单元素集𝟏={∙}\mathbf{1}=\{\bullet\}。对任意集合XX，函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X本质上就是XX的一个元素，因为毕竟这样的函数ff由f⁡(∙)∈Xf(\bullet)\in X的值唯一确定，见图2（c）。因此：

Suppose for now that we have found a characterization of one-element sets without knowing what an element is. (We do so below.) Fix a one-element set 𝟏={∙}\mathbf{1}=\{\bullet\}. For any set XX, a function 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X is essentially just an element of XX, since, after all, such a function ff is uniquely determined by the value of f⁡(∙)∈Xf(\bullet)\in X (Fig. 2(c)). Thus:

元素是函数的一种特殊情形。

Elements are a special case of functions.

这个观察太过简单，人们很容易把它视为一种纯粹形式上的小技巧而不予理会。恰恰相反，类似的对应贯穿于整个数学。例如，见图2：

This is such a trivial observation that one is apt to dismiss it as a mere formal trick. On the contrary, similar correspondences occur throughout mathematics. For example (Fig. 2):

  • ∙\bullet

    拓扑空间XX中的一条环路，就是连续映射S1⟶XS^{1}\longrightarrow X；

    a loop in a topological space XX is a continuous map S1⟶XS^{1}\longrightarrow X;

  • ∙\bullet

    ℝn\mathbb{R}^{n}中的一条直线，就是保距离映射ℝ⟶ℝn\mathbb{R}\longrightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n}；

    a straight line in ℝn\mathbb{R}^{n} is a distance-preserving map ℝ⟶ℝn\mathbb{R}\longrightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n};

  • ∙\bullet

    集合XX中的一个序列，就是函数ℕ⟶X\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow X；

    a sequence in a set XX is a function ℕ⟶X\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow X;

  • ∙\bullet

    环AA中方程x2+y2=1x^{2}+y^{2}=1的一个解(x,y)(x,y)，就是同态ℤ⁡[X,Y]/(X2+Y2−1)⟶A\mathbb{Z}[X,Y]/(X^{2}+Y^{2}-1)\longrightarrow A。

    a solution (x,y)(x,y) of the equation x2+y2=1x^{2}+y^{2}=1 in a ring AA is a homomorphism ℤ⁡[X,Y]/(X2+Y2−1)⟶A\mathbb{Z}[X,Y]/(X^{2}+Y^{2}-1)\longrightarrow A.

在每种情形中，“就是”既可以理解为定义，也可以理解为断言：两者之间存在一个典范的一一对应。第一种情形，我们从圆出发作映射，而圆是一条“自成一体”的环路；第二种情形，ℝ\mathbb{R}是一条自成一体的直线；第三种情形，ℕ\mathbb{N}的元素0,1,2,…0,1,2,\ldots构成一个自成一体的序列；最后一种情形，ℤ⁡[X,Y]/(X2+Y2−1)\mathbb{Z}[X,Y]/(X^{2}+Y^{2}-1)中的一对元素(X,Y)(X,Y)，是x2+y2=1x^{2}+y^{2}=1的自成一体的解(x,y)(x,y)。同样，在眼下这个简单情形中，集合𝟏\mathbf{1}是一个自成一体的元素，而集合XX的一个元素，就只是映射𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X。

In each case, the word ‘is’ can be taken either as a definition or as an assertion of a canonical, one-to-one correspondence. In the first, we map out of the circle, which is a ‘free-standing’ loop; in the second, ℝ\mathbb{R} is a free-standing line; in the third, the elements 0,1,2,…0,1,2,\ldots of ℕ\mathbb{N} form a free-standing sequence; in the last, the pair (X,Y)(X,Y) of elements of ℤ⁡[X,Y]/(X2+Y2−1)\mathbb{Z}[X,Y]/(X^{2}+Y^{2}-1) is the free-standing solution (x,y)(x,y) of x2+y2=1x^{2}+y^{2}=1. Similarly, in our trivial situation, the set 𝟏\mathbf{1} is a free-standing element, and an element of a set XX is just a map 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X.

我们可以讲究一些，例如，用x¯\bar{x}表示取值为x∈Xx\in X的函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X。不过，我们将直接把x¯\bar{x}写成xx，不再明确区分。事实上，稍后我们会把XX的一个元素定义为一个函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X。

We could be fussy and write x¯\bar{x}, say, for the function 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X with value x∈Xx\in X. But we will write x¯\bar{x} as just xx, blurring the distinction. In fact, we will later define an element of XX to be a function 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X.

这会使一些读者感到不自在。你大概承认，XX的元素与函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X之间存在典范的一一对应，但也许不愿进一步说：XX的一个元素，字面意义上就是一个函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X。如果如此，也不妨碍继续讨论。我们可以修改第2节的公理化方案，把“元素”加入原始概念清单。不过，这样还得再增加一些条款，使体系更复杂，以确保诸如以下性质：对任意集合XX，XX的元素与函数𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X之间一一对应。这当然可以做到，但我们选择更经济的路线。

This will make some readers uncomfortable. There is, you will agree, a canonical one-to-one correspondence between elements of XX and functions 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X, but perhaps you draw the line at saying that an element of XX literally is a function 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X. If so, this is not a deal-breaker. We could adapt the axiomatization in Section 2 by adding ‘element’ to the list of primitive concepts. Then, however, we would need to complicate it further by adding clauses to guarantee that (among other things) there is a one-to-one correspondence between elements of XX and functions 𝟏⟶X\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X, for any set XX. It can be done, but we choose the more economical route.

我们已经看到，元素是函数的一种特殊情形。函数与元素之间还有另一种基本相互作用：给定函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y和元素x∈Xx\in X，可以求ff在xx处的值，得到新元素f⁡(x)∈Yf(x)\in Y。把元素视为从𝟏\mathbf{1}出发的函数时，这个元素f⁡(x)f(x)无非是ff与xx的复合：

We have seen that elements are a special case of functions. There is another fundamental way in which functions and elements interact: given a function f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y and an element x∈Xx\in X, we can evaluate ff at xx to obtain a new element, f⁡(x)∈Yf(x)\in Y. Viewing elements as functions out of 𝟏\mathbf{1}, this element f⁡(x)f(x) is nothing but the composite of ff with xx:

求值是复合的一种特殊情形。

Evaluation is a special case of composition.

公理The axioms

这里完全用初等语言，陈述关于集合与函数的十条公理。

Here we state our ten axioms on sets and functions, in entirely elementary terms.

正式的公理化表述采用不同字体，以便与随附的评论区分。文中会出现一些图，但它们不是正式陈述的一部分。

The formal axiomatization is in a different typeface, to distinguish it from the accompanying commentary. Some diagrams appear, but they are not part of the formal statement.

首先列出公理将要适用的资料：

First we state the data to which our axioms will apply:

  • ∙\bullet

    一些称为“集合”的东西；

    Some things called sets;

  • ∙\bullet

    对每个集合XX和集合YY，有一些称为从XX到YY的“函数”的东西；从XX到YY的函数ff，写作f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y或X⟶fYX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y；

    for each set XX and set YY, some things called functions from XX to YY, with functions ff from XX to YY written as f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y or X⟶fYX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y;

  • ∙\bullet

    对每个集合XX、集合YY和集合ZZ，有一种运算，为每个f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y和g:Y⟶Zg\colon Y\longrightarrow Z指定一个函数g∘f:X⟶Zg\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f\colon X\longrightarrow Z；

    for each set XX, set YY and set ZZ, an operation assigning to each f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y and g:Y⟶Zg\colon Y\longrightarrow Z a function g∘f:X⟶Zg\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f\colon X\longrightarrow Z;

  • ∙\bullet

    对每个集合XX，有一个函数1X:X⟶X1_{X}\colon X\longrightarrow X。

    for each set XX, a function 1X:X⟶X1_{X}\colon X\longrightarrow X.

最后一项可以按喜好决定是否列入清单。请看下面第一条公理之后的评论。

This last item can be included in the list or not, according to taste. See the comments after the first axiom, which now follows.

结合律与恒等律Associativity and identity laws

1. 对所有集合W,X,Y,ZW,X,Y,Z以及函数

1. For all sets W,X,Y,ZW,X,Y,Z and functions

W⟶fX⟶gY⟶hZ,W\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f}}{{\longrightarrow}}X\stackrel{{\scriptstyle g}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y\stackrel{{\scriptstyle h}}{{\longrightarrow}}Z,

都有h∘(g∘f)=(h∘g)∘fh\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(g\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f)=(h\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,g)\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f。对所有集合X,YX,Y以及函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y，都有f∘ 1X=f=1Y∘ff\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,1_{X}=f=1_{Y}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f。

we have h∘(g∘f)=(h∘g)∘fh\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(g\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f)=(h\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,g)\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f. For all sets X,YX,Y and functions f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y, we have f∘ 1X=f=1Y∘ff\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,1_{X}=f=1_{Y}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f.

如果想把恒等函数从原始概念清单中删去，就必须把公理1的后半部分改成如下陈述：对所有集合XX，存在函数1X:X⟶X1_{X}\colon X\longrightarrow X，使对所有g:X⟶Yg\colon X\longrightarrow Y都有g∘ 1X=gg\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,1_{X}=g，并且对所有f:W⟶Xf\colon W\longrightarrow X都有1X∘f=f1_{X}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f=f。这些条件唯一刻画了1X1_{X}。

If we wish to omit the identity functions from the list of primitive concepts, we must replace the second half of Axiom 1 by the statement that for all sets XX, there exists a function 1X:X⟶X1_{X}\colon X\longrightarrow X such that g∘ 1X=gg\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,1_{X}=g for all g:X⟶Yg\colon X\longrightarrow Y and 1X∘f=f1_{X}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f=f for all f:W⟶Xf\colon W\longrightarrow X. These conditions characterize 1X1_{X} uniquely.

单元素集One-element set

我们想说“存在一个单元素集”，但眼下还没有足够的表达手段来说“元素”。然而，任何单元素集TT都应该有如下性质：对每个集合XX，恰有一个函数X⟶TX\longrightarrow T。而且，应该只有单元素集才具有这个性质。这就引出了下面的定义和公理。

We would like to say ‘there exists a one-element set’, but for the moment we lack the expressive power to say ‘element’. However, any one-element set TT should have the property that for each set XX, there is precisely one function X⟶TX\longrightarrow T. Moreover, only one-element sets should have this property. This motivates the following definition and axiom.

集合TT称为终集合，如果对每个集合XX，都有唯一函数X⟶TX\longrightarrow T。

A set TT is terminal if for every set XX, there is a unique function X⟶TX\longrightarrow T.

2. 存在一个终集合。

2. There exists a terminal set.

由定义很快可得：如果TT和T′T^{\prime}都是终集合，那么从TT到T′T^{\prime}存在唯一的同构。（函数f:A⟶Bf\colon A\longrightarrow B称为同构，如果存在函数f′:B⟶Af^{\prime}\colon B\longrightarrow A，使f′∘f=1Af^{\prime}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f=1_{A}且f∘f′=1Bf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f^{\prime}=1_{B}。）换句话说，终集合在唯一同构意义下唯一。因此，一劳永逸地固定一个终集合𝟏\mathbf{1}并无妨碍。对此有所顾虑的读者，请看本节最后几段。

It follows quickly from the definitions that if TT and T′T^{\prime} are terminal sets then there is a unique isomorphism from TT to T′T^{\prime}. (A function f:A⟶Bf\colon A\longrightarrow B is an isomorphism if there is a function f′:B⟶Af^{\prime}\colon B\longrightarrow A such that f′∘f=1Af^{\prime}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f=1_{A} and f∘f′=1Bf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,f^{\prime}=1_{B}.) In other words, terminal sets are unique up to unique isomorphism. It is therefore harmless to fix a terminal set 𝟏\mathbf{1} once and for all. Readers worried by this are referred to the last few paragraphs of this section.

给定集合XX，我们用x∈Xx\in X表示x:𝟏⟶Xx\colon\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X，并称xx为XX的一个元素。给定x∈Xx\in X以及函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y，我们用f⁡(x)f(x)表示YY中的元素f∘x:𝟏⟶Yf\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,x\colon\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow Y。

Given a set XX, we write x∈Xx\in X to mean x:𝟏⟶Xx\colon\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow X, and call xx an element of XX. Given x∈Xx\in X and a function f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y, we write f⁡(x)f(x) for the element f∘x:𝟏⟶Yf\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,x\colon\mathbf{1}\longrightarrow Y of YY.

空集Empty set

3. 存在一个没有元素的集合。

3. There exists a set with no elements.

函数与元素Functions and elements

从XX到YY的函数，应当无非就是把XX的元素变成YY的元素的一种方式。

A function from XX to YY should be nothing more than a way of turning elements of XX into elements of YY.

4. 设XX和YY是集合，f,g:X⟶Yf,g\colon X\longrightarrow Y是函数。假设对所有x∈Xx\in X都有f⁡(x)=g⁡(x)f(x)=g(x)，那么f=gf=g。

4. Let XX and YY be sets and f,g:X⟶Yf,g\colon X\longrightarrow Y functions. Suppose that f⁡(x)=g⁡(x)f(x)=g(x) for all x∈Xx\in X. Then f=gf=g.

公理1、2和4蕴含：一个集合是终集合，当且仅当它恰好有一个元素。因此，可以把“单元素集”用作“终集合”的同义词。

Axioms 1, 2 and 4 imply that a set is terminal if and only if it has exactly one element. This justifies the usage of ‘one-element set’ as a synonym for ‘terminal set’.

笛卡尔积Cartesian products

我们希望能够构造集合的笛卡尔积。XX的一个元素与YY的一个元素，应当唯一确定X×YX\times Y的一个元素。更一般地，对任意集合II，函数f1:I⟶Xf_{1}\colon I\longrightarrow X与函数f2:I⟶Yf_{2}\colon I\longrightarrow Y应当唯一确定一个由f⁡(t)=(f1​(t),f2​(t))f(t)=(f_{1}(t),f_{2}(t))给出的函数f:I⟶X×Yf\colon I\longrightarrow X\times Y。（取I=𝟏I=\mathbf{1}，就能看出这确实“更一般”。）把ff与投影p1:X×Y⟶Xp_{1}\colon X\times Y\longrightarrow X复合，可以找回f1f_{1}；同样也能找回f2f_{2}。这就引出下面的定义。

We want to be able to form cartesian products of sets. An element of XX together with an element of YY should uniquely determine an element of X×YX\times Y. More generally, for any set II, a function f1:I⟶Xf_{1}\colon I\longrightarrow X together with a function f2:I⟶Yf_{2}\colon I\longrightarrow Y should uniquely determine a function f:I⟶X×Yf\colon I\longrightarrow X\times Y, given by f⁡(t)=(f1​(t),f2​(t))f(t)=(f_{1}(t),f_{2}(t)). (To see that this really is ‘more generally’, take I=𝟏I=\mathbf{1}.) We can recover f1f_{1} from ff by composing with the projection p1:X×Y⟶Xp_{1}\colon X\times Y\longrightarrow X, and similarly f2f_{2}, as in the following definition.

设XX和YY是集合。XX与YY的一个积，是集合PP及函数X⟵p1P⟶p2YX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p_{1}}}{{\longleftarrow}}P\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p_{2}}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y，并满足如下性质：

Let XX and YY be sets. A product of XX and YY is a set PP together with functions X⟵p1P⟶p2YX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p_{1}}}{{\longleftarrow}}P\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p_{2}}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y, with the following property:

对所有集合II和函数X⟵f1I⟶f2YX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f_{1}}}{{\longleftarrow}}I\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f_{2}}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y，存在唯一函数(f1,f2):I⟶P(f_{1},f_{2})\colon I\longrightarrow P，使p1∘(f1,f2)=f1p_{1}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(f_{1},f_{2})=f_{1}且p2∘(f1,f2)=f2p_{2}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(f_{1},f_{2})=f_{2}。

for all sets II and functions X⟵f1I⟶f2YX\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f_{1}}}{{\longleftarrow}}I\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f_{2}}}{{\longrightarrow}}Y,
there is a unique function (f1,f2):I⟶P(f_{1},f_{2})\colon I\longrightarrow P
such that p1∘(f1,f2)=f1p_{1}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(f_{1},f_{2})=f_{1} and p2∘(f1,f2)=f2p_{2}\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,(f_{1},f_{2})=f_{2}.

5. 每一对集合都有积。

5. Every pair of sets has a product.

严格地说，积不仅包含集合PP，还包含投影p1p_{1}和p2p_{2}。XX与YY的任意两个积之间，都有唯一的相容同构：也就是说，给定积(P,p1,p2)(P,p_{1},p_{2})与(P′,p1′,p2′)(P^{\prime},p^{\prime}_{1},p^{\prime}_{2})，存在唯一同构i:P⟶P′i\colon P\longrightarrow P^{\prime}，使p1′∘i=p1p^{\prime}_{1}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=p_{1}且p2′∘i=p2p^{\prime}_{2}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=p_{2}。和终集合的情形一样，这使得我们可以为每一对集合XX、YY，一劳永逸地选定一个优先使用的积(X×Y,pr1X,Y,pr2X,Y)(X\times Y,\mathrm{pr}^{X,Y}_{1},\mathrm{pr}^{X,Y}_{2})，而不产生问题。本节末尾也会说明这一约定的正当性。

Strictly speaking, a product consists of not only the set PP but also the projections p1p_{1} and p2p_{2}. Any two products of XX and YY are uniquely isomorphic: that is, given products (P,p1,p2)(P,p_{1},p_{2}) and (P′,p1′,p2′)(P^{\prime},p^{\prime}_{1},p^{\prime}_{2}), there is a unique isomorphism i:P⟶P′i\colon P\longrightarrow P^{\prime} such that p1′∘i=p1p^{\prime}_{1}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=p_{1} and p2′∘i=p2p^{\prime}_{2}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=p_{2}. As in the case of terminal sets, this makes it harmless to choose once and for all a preferred product (X×Y,pr1X,Y,pr2X,Y)(X\times Y,\mathrm{pr}^{X,Y}_{1},\mathrm{pr}^{X,Y}_{2}) for each pair XX, YY of sets. Again, this convention is justified at the end of the section.

函数集Sets of functions

在日常数学中，我们可以构造从集合XX到集合YY的函数所成的集合YXY^{X}。对任意集合II，函数q:I×X⟶Yq\colon I\times X\longrightarrow Y与函数q¯:I⟶YX\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow Y^{X}之间一一对应，只需改变标点：

In everyday mathematics, we can form the set YXY^{X} of functions from one set XX to another set YY. For any set II, the functions q:I×X⟶Yq\colon I\times X\longrightarrow Y correspond one-to-one with the functions q¯:I⟶YX\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow Y^{X}, simply by changing the punctuation:

q​(t,x)=(q¯​(t))​(x)q(t,x)=(\bar{q}(t))(x) (1)

其中t∈It\in I、x∈Xx\in X。例如，当I=𝟏I=\mathbf{1}时，这就化为：函数X⟶YX\longrightarrow Y与YXY^{X}的元素相对应。

(t∈It\in I, x∈Xx\in X). For example, when I=𝟏I=\mathbf{1}, this reduces to the statement that the functions X⟶YX\longrightarrow Y correspond to the elements of YXY^{X}.

在式（1）中，我们隐含地使用了求值映射

In (1), we are implicitly using the evaluation map

ε:YX×X⟶Y(f,x)⟼f⁡(x).\begin{array}[]{cccc}\varepsilon\colon&Y^{X}\times X&\longrightarrow&Y\\ &(f,x)&\longmapsto&f(x).\end{array}

于是，式（1）就变成等式q⁡(t,x)=ε⁡(q¯​(t),x)q(t,x)=\varepsilon(\bar{q}(t),x)，如下述定义所示。

Then (1) becomes the equation q⁡(t,x)=ε⁡(q¯​(t),x)q(t,x)=\varepsilon(\bar{q}(t),x), as in the following definition.

设XX和YY是集合。从XX到YY的一个函数集，是集合FF及函数ε:F×X⟶Y\varepsilon\colon F\times X\longrightarrow Y，并满足如下性质：

Let XX and YY be sets. A function set from XX to YY is a set FF together with a function ε:F×X⟶Y\varepsilon\colon F\times X\longrightarrow Y, with the following property:

对所有集合II和函数q:I×X⟶Yq\colon I\times X\longrightarrow Y，存在唯一函数q¯:I⟶F\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow F，使对所有t∈It\in I、x∈Xx\in X都有q⁡(t,x)=ε⁡(q¯​(t),x)q(t,x)=\varepsilon(\bar{q}(t),x)。

for all sets II and functions q:I×X⟶Yq\colon I\times X\longrightarrow Y,
there is a unique function q¯:I⟶F\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow F
such that q⁡(t,x)=ε⁡(q¯​(t),x)q(t,x)=\varepsilon(\bar{q}(t),x) for all t∈It\in I, x∈Xx\in X.

6. 对所有集合XX和YY，都存在从XX到YY的函数集。

6. For all sets XX and YY, there exists a function set from XX to YY.

逆像Inverse images

通常，给定函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y以及YY的一个元素yy，我们可以构造逆像，或称纤维f−1​(y)f^{-1}(y)。包含函数j:f−1​(y)↪Xj\colon f^{-1}(y)\hookrightarrow X有如下性质：f∘jf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,j是常值yy。而且，只要函数q:I⟶Xq\colon I\longrightarrow X使f∘qf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,q为常值yy，qq的像就必定位于f−1​(y)f^{-1}(y)之内；也就是说，对某个必然唯一的q¯:I⟶f−1​(y)\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow f^{-1}(y)，有q=j∘q¯q=j\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,\bar{q}。

Ordinarily, given a function f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y and an element yy of YY, we can form the inverse image or fibre f−1​(y)f^{-1}(y). The inclusion function j:f−1​(y)↪Xj\colon f^{-1}(y)\hookrightarrow X has the property that f∘jf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,j has constant value yy. Moreover, whenever q:I⟶Xq\colon I\longrightarrow X is a function such that f∘qf\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,q has constant value yy, the image of qq must lie within f−1​(y)f^{-1}(y); that is, q=j∘q¯q=j\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,\bar{q} for some q¯:I⟶f−1​(y)\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow f^{-1}(y) (necessarily unique).

设f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y是函数，且y∈Yy\in Y。yy在ff下的一个逆像，是集合AA及函数j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X；对所有a∈Aa\in A都有f⁡(j⁡(a))=yf(j(a))=y，并且满足如下性质：

Let f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y be a function and y∈Yy\in Y. An inverse image of yy under ff is a set AA together with a function j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X, such that f⁡(j⁡(a))=yf(j(a))=y for all a∈Aa\in A and the following property holds:

对所有集合II以及满足对所有t∈It\in I都有f⁡(q⁡(t))=yf(q(t))=y的函数q:I⟶Xq\colon I\longrightarrow X，都存在唯一函数q¯:I⟶A\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow A，使q=j∘q¯q=j\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,\bar{q}。

for all sets II and functions q:I⟶Xq\colon I\longrightarrow X such that
 f⁡(q⁡(t))=yf(q(t))=y for all t∈It\in I,
there is a unique function q¯:I⟶A\bar{q}\colon I\longrightarrow A
such that q=j∘q¯q=j\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,\bar{q}.

7. 对每个函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y以及元素y∈Yy\in Y，都存在yy在ff下的逆像。

7. For every function f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y and element y∈Yy\in Y, there exists an inverse image of yy under ff.

逆像在本质上是唯一的：若j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X和j′:A′⟶Xj^{\prime}\colon A^{\prime}\longrightarrow X都是yy在ff下的逆像，则存在唯一同构i:A⟶A′i\colon A\longrightarrow A^{\prime}，使j′∘i=jj^{\prime}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=j。

Inverse images are essentially unique: if j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X and j′:A′⟶Xj^{\prime}\colon A^{\prime}\longrightarrow X are both inverse images of yy under ff, there is a unique isomorphism i:A⟶A′i\colon A\longrightarrow A^{\prime} such that j′∘i=jj^{\prime}\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=j.

特征函数Characteristic functions

有时，我们想分情况定义函数。例如，可能想通过规定：若x≠0x\neq 0则h⁡(x)=x​sin⁡(1/x)h(x)=x\sin(1/x)，并且h⁡(0)=0h(0)=0，来定义h:ℝ⟶ℝh\colon\mathbb{R}\longrightarrow\mathbb{R}。特征函数的定义就是一个简单例子。

Sometimes we want to define a function on a case-by-case basis. For example, we might want to define h:ℝ⟶ℝh\colon\mathbb{R}\longrightarrow\mathbb{R} by h⁡(x)=x​sin⁡(1/x)h(x)=x\sin(1/x) if x≠0x\neq 0 and h⁡(0)=0h(0)=0. A simple instance is the definition of characteristic function.

固定一个二元素集𝟐={t,f}\mathbf{2}=\{t,f\}，其中两个值分别代表“真”和“假”。子集A⊆XA\subseteq X的特征函数，是如下定义的函数χA:X⟶𝟐\chi_{A}\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}：若x∈Ax\in A，则χA​(x)=t\chi_{A}(x)=t；否则，χA​(x)=f\chi_{A}(x)=f。它是满足χ−1​(t)=A\chi^{-1}(t)=A的唯一函数χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}。

Fix a two element-set 𝟐={t,f}\mathbf{2}=\{t,f\} (for ‘true’ and ‘false’). The characteristic function of a subset A⊆XA\subseteq X is the function χA:X⟶𝟐\chi_{A}\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2} defined by χA​(x)=t\chi_{A}(x)=t if x∈Ax\in A and χA​(x)=f\chi_{A}(x)=f otherwise. It is the unique function χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2} such that χ−1​(t)=A\chi^{-1}(t)=A.

这就是特征函数通常的作用方式。为了保证它们在我们的集合论中也以同样方式工作，现在要求存在一个集合𝟐\mathbf{2}及一个元素t∈𝟐t\in\mathbf{2}，具有刚才描述的性质：只要XX是集合且A⊆XA\subseteq X，就存在唯一函数χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}，使χ−1​(t)=A\chi^{-1}(t)=A。

This is how characteristic functions work ordinarily. To ensure that they work in the same way in our set theory, we now demand that there exist a set 𝟐\mathbf{2} and an element t∈𝟐t\in\mathbf{2} with the property just described: whenever XX is a set and A⊆XA\subseteq X, there is a unique function χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2} such that χ−1​(t)=A\chi^{-1}(t)=A.

由于我们还没有定义子集，公理改用单射来表述。这是可行的，因为每个子集包含映射A↪XA\hookrightarrow X都是单射；反过来，在同构意义下，每个单射也都是这样产生的。

Since we do not yet have a definition of subset, we phrase the axiom in terms of injections instead. This works because every subset inclusion A↪XA\hookrightarrow X is injective, and, up to isomorphism, every injection arises in this way.

单射是一个满足如下条件的函数j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X：对a,a′∈Aa,a^{\prime}\in A，有j⁡(a)=j⁡(a′)⟹a=a′j(a)=j(a^{\prime})\implies a=a^{\prime}。

An injection is a function j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X such that j⁡(a)=j⁡(a′)⟹a=a′j(a)=j(a^{\prime})\implies a=a^{\prime} for a,a′∈Aa,a^{\prime}\in A.

子集分类子，是集合𝟐\mathbf{2}及元素t∈𝟐t\in\mathbf{2}，并满足如下性质：

A subset classifier is a set 𝟐\mathbf{2} together with an element t∈𝟐t\in\mathbf{2}, with the following property:

对所有集合A,XA,X和单射j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X，存在唯一函数χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}，使j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X是tt在χ\chi下的一个逆像。

for all sets A,XA,X and injections j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X,
there is a unique function χ:X⟶𝟐\chi\colon X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2} such that
j:A⟶Xj\colon A\longrightarrow X is an inverse image of tt under χ\chi.

8. 存在一个子集分类子。

8. There exists a subset classifier.

记号𝟐\mathbf{2}只是一种提示。定义中没有任何规定说𝟐\mathbf{2}必须恰有两个元素；不过，我们的十条公理确实蕴含这一点，而这并不是一个平凡的结论。

The notation 𝟐\mathbf{2} is merely suggestive. There is nothing in the definition saying that 𝟐\mathbf{2} must have two elements, but, nontrivially, our ten axioms do in fact imply this.

自然数Natural numbers

在通常的数学中，序列可以递归定义：给定集合XX、元素a∈Xa\in X以及函数r:X⟶Xr\colon X\longrightarrow X，XX中存在唯一序列(xn)n=0∞(x_{n})_{n=0}^{\infty}，使

In ordinary mathematics, sequences can be defined recursively: given a set XX, an element a∈Xa\in X, and a function r:X⟶Xr\colon X\longrightarrow X, there is a unique sequence (xn)n=0∞(x_{n})_{n=0}^{\infty} in XX such that

x0=a​ and ​xn+1=r⁡(xn)​ for all ​n∈ℕ.x_{0}=a\text{ and }x_{n+1}=r(x_{n})\text{ for all }n\in\mathbb{N}.

XX中的一个序列，无非就是一个函数ℕ⟶X\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow X，因此上一句话实际上是在陈述集合ℕ\mathbb{N}的一个性质。它还涉及ℕ\mathbb{N}上的两项结构：元素00，以及由s⁡(n)=n+1s(n)=n+1给出的函数s:ℕ⟶ℕs\colon\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow\mathbb{N}。

A sequence in XX is nothing but a function ℕ⟶X\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow X, so the previous sentence is really a statement about the set ℕ\mathbb{N}. It also refers to two pieces of structure on ℕ\mathbb{N}: the element 00 and the function s:ℕ⟶ℕs\colon\mathbb{N}\longrightarrow\mathbb{N} given by s⁡(n)=n+1s(n)=n+1.

自然数系统，是集合NN及元素0∈N0\in N和函数s:N⟶Ns\colon N\longrightarrow N，并满足如下性质：

A natural number system is a set NN together with an element 0∈N0\in N and a function s:N⟶Ns\colon N\longrightarrow N, with the following property:

只要XX是集合，a∈Xa\in X且r:X⟶Xr\colon X\longrightarrow X，就存在唯一函数x:N⟶Xx\colon N\longrightarrow X，使x⁡(0)=ax(0)=a，并且对所有n∈Nn\in N都有x⁡(s⁡(n))=r⁡(x⁡(n))x(s(n))=r(x(n))。

whenever XX is a set, a∈Xa\in X, and r:X⟶Xr\colon X\longrightarrow X,
there is a unique function x:N⟶Xx\colon N\longrightarrow X such that
x⁡(0)=ax(0)=a and x⁡(s⁡(n))=r⁡(x⁡(n))x(s(n))=r(x(n)) for all n∈Nn\in N.

9. 存在一个自然数系统。

9. There exists a natural number system.

自然数系统在通常意义下本质唯一：任意两个自然数系统之间，都有唯一保持结构的同构。这就使我们可以像平常那样，谈论“那个”自然数系统ℕ\mathbb{N}。

Natural number systems are essentially unique, in the usual sense that between any two of them there is a unique structure-preserving isomorphism. This justifies speaking of the natural numbers ℕ\mathbb{N}, as we invariably do.

选择Choice

有右逆的函数当然是满射。选择公理断言其逆命题也成立。

A function with a right inverse is certainly surjective. The axiom of choice states the converse.

满射是一个满足如下条件的函数s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y：对所有y∈Yy\in Y，都存在x∈Xx\in X，使s⁡(x)=ys(x)=y。

A surjection is a function s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y such that for all y∈Yy\in Y, there exists x∈Xx\in X with s⁡(x)=ys(x)=y.

函数s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y的一个右逆，是满足s∘i=1Ys\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=1_{Y}的函数i:Y⟶Xi\colon Y\longrightarrow X。

A right inverse of a function s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y is a function i:Y⟶Xi\colon Y\longrightarrow X such that s∘i=1Ys\,\raisebox{0.35556pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i=1_{Y}.

10. 每个满射都有右逆。

10. Every surjection has a right inverse.

满射s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y的一个右逆，就是对每个y∈Yy\in Y，从非空集合s−1​(y)s^{-1}(y)中选取一个元素。

A right inverse of a surjection s:X⟶Ys\colon X\longrightarrow Y is a choice, for each y∈Yy\in Y, of an element of the nonempty set s−1​(y)s^{-1}(y).

至此，公理化表述完成。

This concludes the axiomatization.

“那个”的含义The meaning of ‘the’

我们还需要打消一些读者的顾虑：在公理2和5中，我们曾自由地一劳永逸选定一个终集合，并为每一对集合选定一个笛卡尔积。

It remains to reassure any readers concerned by the liberty taken in Axioms 2 and 5, where we chose once and for all a terminal set and a cartesian product for each pair of sets.

这种自由在数学实践中极其常见。我们谈论“那个”平凡群、“那个”二维球面、两个向量空间的“那个”直和，等等；尽管我们可以设想许多平凡群、二维球面或直和，它们彼此同构，却并不相等。若有人追问“可到底是哪一个平凡群？”，多半会招来严厉的注视，而且理由充分：关于群的任何有意义的陈述，都不取决于平凡群的那个元素碰巧叫什么名字。

This type of liberty is very common in mathematical practice. We speak of the trivial group, the 2-sphere, the direct sum of two vector spaces, etc., even though we can conceive of many trivial groups or 2-spheres or direct sums, all isomorphic but not equal. Anyone asking ‘but which trivial group?’ is likely to be met with a hard stare, for good reason: no meaningful statement about groups depends on what the element of the trivial group happens to be called.

不过，我们应当能够以一丝不苟的严格性陈述公理，而这确实做得到。一种办法，是不单独指定某个终集合或某些积，而改用较迂回的措辞；例如，把“对所有元素x∈Xx\in X”换成“对所有终集合TT以及函数x:T⟶Xx\colon T\longrightarrow X”。

However, we should be able to state the axioms with scrupulous rigour, and we can. One way to do so is not to single out a particular terminal set or particular products, but instead to adopt some circumlocutions: for example, replacing the phrase ‘for all elements x∈Xx\in X’ by ‘for all terminal sets TT and functions x:T⟶Xx\colon T\longrightarrow X’.

但更令人满意的做法，是扩充原始概念清单。在已有的集合、函数、复合和恒等函数之外，再加入：

More satisfactory, though, is to extend the list of primitive concepts. To the existing list (sets, functions, composition and identities) we add:

  • ∙\bullet

    一个指定的集合𝟏\mathbf{1}；

    a distinguished set, 𝟏\mathbf{1};

  • ∙\bullet

    一种运算，为每一对集合X,YX,Y指定一个集合X×YX\times Y以及函数

    an operation assigning to each pair of sets X,YX,Y a set X×YX\times Y and functions

    (2)

把公理2改为“𝟏\mathbf{1}是终集合”，把公理5改为：对所有集合XX和YY，集合X×YX\times Y连同函数（2），是XX与YY的一个积。

Axiom 2 is replaced by the statement that 𝟏\mathbf{1} is terminal, and Axiom 5 by the statement that for all sets XX and YY, the set X×YX\times Y together with the functions (2) is a product of XX and YY.

这种做法的优点，是反映了通常的数学用法。我们说起两个集合，或者空间、群等等，的积时，通常仿佛把取积当作一个有确定输出的过程：得到的是“那个”积，而不是“某个”积。不过，积无论如何都在唯一同构意义下唯一确定，所以是否指定其中一个为特殊对象，并没有实质区别。

This approach has the virtue of reflecting ordinary mathematical usage. We usually speak as if taking the product of two sets (or spaces, groups, etc.) were a procedure with a definite output: the product, not a product. But since products are in any case determined uniquely up to unique isomorphism, whether or not we nominate one as special makes no significant difference.

讨论Discussion

这十条公理的直观内容很熟悉，但把它们作为一个公理系统来看，却不那么熟悉。这里讨论如此使用它们会带来什么影响。

The ten axioms are familiar in their intuitive content, but less so as an axiomatic system. Here we discuss the implications of using them as such.

在公理之上构建Building on the axioms

任何事物的公理化，随后都会有一段证明引理的时期。眼前这套公理也不例外。下面极简略地勾画其发展。

Any axiomatization of anything is followed by a period of lemma-proving. The present axioms are no exception. Here is a very brief sketch of the development.

形式上，把集合XX的一个子集定义为函数X⟶𝟐X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}很方便；不过，我们会不断使用公理8提供的对应：函数X⟶𝟐X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}与映入XX的单射相对应。映入XX的两个单射jj、j′j^{\prime}，对应于XX的同一个子集，当且仅当它们有相同的像；也就是说，存在同构ii使j′=j∘ij^{\prime}=j\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i。

It is convenient formally to define a subset of a set XX as a function X⟶𝟐X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2}, but we constantly use the correspondence between functions X⟶𝟐X\longrightarrow\mathbf{2} and injections into XX, provided by Axiom 8. Two injections jj, j′j^{\prime} into XX correspond to the same subset of XX if and only if they have the same image (that is, there exists an isomorphism ii such that j′=j∘ij^{\prime}=j\,\raisebox{0.34444pt}{$\scriptstyle\circ$}\,i).

主要任务，是建立日常操作集合所需的工具。例如，给定函数f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y，我们构造XX的子集在ff下的像，以及YY的子集的逆像。集合XX上的等价关系∼\sim，定义为具有通常性质的X×XX\times X的子集，而这些公理使我们能够构造商集X/∼X/\!\!\sim。某些构造颇费周折：例如，公理蕴含任意两个集合XX和YY都有不交并X⊔YX\sqcup Y，但这绝不是显而易见的。

The main task is to build the everyday equipment used for manipulating sets. For example, given a function f:X⟶Yf\colon X\longrightarrow Y, we construct the image under ff of a subset of XX and the inverse image of a subset of YY. An equivalence relation ∼\sim on a set XX is defined to be a subset of X×XX\times X with the customary properties, and the axioms allow us to construct the quotient set X/∼X/\!\!\sim. Some constructions are tricky: for instance, the axioms imply that any two sets XX and YY have a disjoint union X⊔YX\sqcup Y, but this is by no means obvious.

接着定义通常的数系。自然数的加法、乘法与乘幂，可以直接用公理9来定义。然后以标准方式，从ℕ\mathbb{N}依次构造ℤ\mathbb{Z}、ℚ\mathbb{Q}、ℝ\mathbb{R}与ℂ\mathbb{C}。例如，ℤ=(ℕ×ℕ)/∼\mathbb{Z}=(\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N})/\!\!\sim，其中∼\sim是ℕ×ℕ\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N}上的等价关系，规定为：(m,n)∼(m′,n′)(m,n)\sim(m^{\prime},n^{\prime})当且仅当m+n′=m′+nm+n^{\prime}=m^{\prime}+n。这个例子表明，越过某一点之后，这里的发展就与其他集合公理化体系的发展完全一样了。

We then define the usual number systems. Addition, multiplication and powers of natural numbers are defined directly using Axiom 9. From ℕ\mathbb{N} we successively construct ℤ\mathbb{Z}, ℚ\mathbb{Q}, ℝ\mathbb{R} and ℂ\mathbb{C}, in the standard way. For example, ℤ=(ℕ×ℕ)/∼\mathbb{Z}=(\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N})/\!\!\sim, where ∼\sim is the equivalence relation on ℕ×ℕ\mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N} given by (m,n)∼(m′,n′)(m,n)\sim(m^{\prime},n^{\prime}) if and only if m+n′=m′+nm+n^{\prime}=m^{\prime}+n. As this illustrates, past a certain point, the development is literally identical to that for other axiomatizations of sets.

这些公理有多强？How strong are the axioms?

大多数数学家所使用的集合性质，永远不会超出这十条公理所保证的范围。例如，麦克拉蒂[13]论证说，格罗滕迪克代数几何学派的经典著作——多卷本《代数几何基础》（EGA）和《代数几何讨论班》（SGA）——在任何地方都不需要更多公理。

Most mathematicians will never use more properties of sets than those guaranteed by the ten axioms. For example, McLarty [13] argues that no more is needed anywhere in the canons of the Grothendieck school of algebraic geometry, the multi-volume works Éléments de Géométrie Algébrique (EGA) and Séminaire de Géométrie Algébrique (SGA).

为了了解这些公理能走多远，我们考察无穷笛卡尔积。设II是一个可能无穷的集合，(Xi)i∈I(X_{i})_{i\in I}是一个集合族。能否构造积∏i∈IXi\prod_{i\in I}X_{i}？这取决于“族”的含义。可以把一个II指标的族定义为集合XX及函数p:X⟶Ip\colon X\longrightarrow I，把纤维p−1​(i)p^{-1}(i)视为第ii个成员XiX_{i}。在这种情形下，可以把∏Xi\prod X_{i}构造为XIX^{I}的一个子集。具体说，pp诱导函数pI:XI⟶IIp^{I}\colon X^{I}\longrightarrow I^{I}，而∏Xi\prod X_{i}是III^{I}中与1I1_{I}对应的元素在pIp^{I}下的逆像。

To get a sense of the reach of the axioms, let us consider infinite cartesian products. Let II be a (possibly infinite) set and (Xi)i∈I(X_{i})_{i\in I} a family of sets. Can we form the product ∏i∈IXi\prod_{i\in I}X_{i}? It depends on what is meant by ‘family’. We could define an II-indexed family to be a set XX together with a function p:X⟶Ip\colon X\longrightarrow I, viewing the fibre p−1​(i)p^{-1}(i) as the iith member XiX_{i}. In that case, ∏Xi\prod X_{i} can be constructed as a subset of XIX^{I}. Specifically, pp induces a function pI:XI⟶IIp^{I}\colon X^{I}\longrightarrow I^{I}, and ∏Xi\prod X_{i} is the inverse image under pIp^{I} of the element of III^{I} corresponding to 1I1_{I}.

然而，也可以对“II指标的族”作另一种解释：一个算法或公式，为每个i∈Ii\in I指定一个集合XiX_{i}。此时，能否构造不交并X=∐i∈IXiX=\coprod_{i\in I}X_{i}就并不明显；而要得到上一种意义下的族，这一步是必需的。事实上，用𝒫⁡(S)=𝟐S\mathcal{P}(S)=\mathbf{2}^{S}表示集合SS的幂集，则这十条公理并不保证下列不交并存在：

However, we could interpret ‘II-indexed family’ differently: as an algorithm or formula that assigns to each i∈Ii\in I a set XiX_{i}. It is not obvious that we can then form the disjoint union X=∐i∈IXiX=\coprod_{i\in I}X_{i}, which is what would be necessary in order to obtain a family in the previous sense. In fact, writing 𝒫⁡(S)=𝟐S\mathcal{P}(S)=\mathbf{2}^{S} for the power set of a set SS, the ten axioms do not guarantee the existence of the disjoint union

ℕ⊔𝒫⁡(ℕ)⊔𝒫⁡(𝒫⁡(ℕ))⊔⋯\mathbb{N}\sqcup\mathcal{P}(\mathbb{N})\sqcup\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\mathbb{N}))\sqcup\cdots (3)

除非这些公理本身不相容，参见[8]第9节。

unless they are inconsistent ([8], Section 9).

如果想改变这一点，可以增加第十一条公理，严格地说是一条公理模式，称为“替代公理”，非正式表述如下：假设有一个集合II，以及一个一阶公式，为每个i∈Ii\in I在同构意义下指定一个集合XiX_{i}。那么，我们要求存在集合XX及函数p:X⟶Ip\colon X\longrightarrow I，使对每个i∈Ii\in I，p−1​(i)p^{-1}(i)都与XiX_{i}同构。正式表述见[12]第8节。这就保证了式（3）这类集合的存在。

If we wish to change this, we can add an eleventh axiom (or properly, axiom scheme), called ‘replacement’ and informally stated as follows. Suppose we have a set II and a first-order formula that for each i∈Ii\in I specifies a set XiX_{i} up to isomorphism. Then we require that there exist a set XX and a function p:X⟶Ip\colon X\longrightarrow I such that p−1​(i)p^{-1}(i) is isomorphic to XiX_{i} for each i∈Ii\in I. (See Section 8 of [12] for a formal statement.) This guarantees the existence of sets such as (3).

我们的公理与ZFC之间的关系，已经得到充分理解。这十条公理比ZFC弱；但加入第十一条之后，两个理论就具有相同强度，并且“可双向解释”，即成立的定理相同。此外，人们还知道，这十条公理对应于ZFC的哪个片段：“带有界概括公理和选择公理的策梅洛集合论”。这一关系的细节，大部分在20世纪70年代初就已厘清[2, 14, 15]。现代的良好介绍，见[7]第VI.10节及[9]第22章。

The relationship between our axioms and ZFC is well understood. The ten axioms are weaker than ZFC; but when the eleventh is added, the two theories have equal strength and are ‘bi-interpretable’ (the same theorems hold). Moreover, it is known to which fragment of ZFC the ten axioms correspond: ‘Zermelo with bounded comprehension and choice’. The details of this relationship were mostly worked out in the early 1970s [2, 14, 15]. Good modern accounts are in Section VI.10 of [7] and Chapter 22 of [9].

更广阔的视野A broader view

我们的十条公理，是劳维尔于1964年发表的“集合范畴初等理论”（ETCS）的一种标准改述。过了若干年，随着拓扑斯理论的出现，ETCS才找到了自己的自然归宿。

Our ten axioms are a standard rephrasing of Lawvere’s Elementary Theory of the Category of Sets (ETCS), published in 1964. It was some years before ETCS found its natural home, and that was with the advent of topos theory.

格罗滕迪克发明拓扑斯概念，出于与集合论毫无关系的原因。对他来说，拓扑斯是一种广义拓扑空间。形式上，拓扑斯是具有某些性质的范畴；拓扑空间XX对应一个拓扑斯，其对象是XX上的集合层。

The notion of topos was invented by Grothendieck for reasons that had nothing to do with set theory. For Grothendieck, a topos was a generalized topological space. Formally, a topos is a category with certain properties, and a topological space XX is associated with the topos whose objects are the sheaves of sets on XX.

劳维尔和蒂尔尼很快意识到：稍微放宽格罗滕迪克的定义，ETCS公理就能用拓扑斯理论的语言简洁地重述[16, 17]。事实上，ETCS恰好断言：集合与函数构成一个特殊种类的拓扑斯，即“带自然数对象和选择公理的良点拓扑斯”。因此，拓扑斯不仅是一种广义空间，也是一种广义的集合宇宙。

Lawvere and Tierney swiftly realized that, after a slight loosening of Grothendieck’s definition, the ETCS axioms could be restated neatly in topos-theoretic terms [16, 17]. Indeed, ETCS says exactly that sets and functions form a topos of a special sort: a ‘well-pointed topos with natural numbers object and choice’. So a topos is not only a generalized space; it is also a generalized universe of sets.

ETCS一个很有吸引力的特点是：每条公理在比集合论更广阔的背景中也都有意义。例如，公理1断言集合与函数构成一个范畴。其余公理的任务，是把集合与其他构成范畴的结构区分开。公理2和5断言集合范畴具有有限积。拓扑空间范畴、光滑流形范畴等也具有这一重要性质，而这正是定义“拓扑群”和“李群”成为可能的原因。除去一处细节，公理1、2、5、6、7和8断言的就是：集合与函数构成一个拓扑斯。

An attractive feature of ETCS is that each of the axioms is meaningful in a broader context than set theory. For example, Axiom 1 states that sets and functions form a category. The job of the remaining axioms is to distinguish sets from other structures that form categories. Axioms 2 and 5 state that the category of sets has finite products. This important property is shared by (for example) the categories of topological spaces and smooth manifolds, which is exactly what makes it possible to define ‘topological group’ and ‘Lie group’. But for one detail, Axioms 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 state that sets and functions form a topos.

再来看公理10，其中选择公理的表述凸显了集合的一项特殊性质。在大多数其他“带结构的集合”所构成的范畴中，它并不成立，而这种不成立本身就很有研究价值。例如，拓扑空间之间的连续满射，不一定有连续的右逆；一个典型例子，就是复平面上不存在连续定义的平方根。

Skipping to Axiom 10, the axiom of choice as formulated there highlights a special feature of sets. In most other categories of sets-with-structure, it fails, and its failure is a point of interest. For instance, not every continuous surjection between topological spaces has a continuous right inverse, a typical example being the nonexistence of a continuous square root defined on the complex plane.

我们应该教授什么样的集合论？What kind of set theory should we teach?

正如图1所示，即便在入门课程里，我们也已经在教授这十条公理的某种淡化版本。例如，我们肯定会告诉学生：X×YX\times Y的一个元素，就是XX的一个元素加上YY的一个元素；而且，我们经常把取值于ℝ2\mathbb{R}^{2}的函数ff写成(f1,f2)(f_{1},f_{2})。不过，我们不大可能明确陈述：给定函数f1:I⟶Xf_{1}\colon I\longrightarrow X和f2:I⟶Yf_{2}\colon I\longrightarrow Y，存在一个以f1f_{1}和f2f_{2}为分量的唯一函数f:I⟶X×Yf\colon I\longrightarrow X\times Y。

As Fig. 1 indicates, we already teach a diluted form of the ten axioms, even in introductory courses. For example, we certainly tell our students that an element of X×YX\times Y is an element of XX together with an element of YY, and we routinely write a function ff taking values in ℝ2\mathbb{R}^{2} as (f1,f2)(f_{1},f_{2}), although we are less likely to state explicitly that given functions f1:I⟶Xf_{1}\colon I\longrightarrow X and f2:I⟶Yf_{2}\colon I\longrightarrow Y, there is a unique function f:I⟶X×Yf\colon I\longrightarrow X\times Y with f1f_{1} and f2f_{2} as components.

至于教授公理集合论，这里概述的方法既有优点，也有缺点。最大的优点是：这样的课程比采用传统公理的课程能惠及广泛得多的学习者。它直接面对许多学生遇到的一个难点：函数概念，以及更难的函数空间概念。它还在一个初等背景中引入了泛性质的思想。这大概是学习者理解这些公理时最困难的一面；但由于泛性质在高等数学的许多分支中都很重要，潜在收益十分深远。

When it comes to teaching axiomatic set theory, the approach outlined here has advantages and disadvantages. The big advantage is that such a course is of far wider benefit than one using the traditional axioms. It directly addresses a difficulty experienced by many students: the concept of function (and worse, function space). It also introduces in an elementary setting the idea of universal property. This is probably the hardest aspect of the axioms for a learner, but since universal properties are important in so many branches of advanced mathematics, the benefits are potentially far-reaching.

缺点也许只是暂时的。目前缺乏教学材料，主要的例外是[5]这本书。例如，公理蕴含任意两个集合都有不交并；大多数拓扑斯理论书籍都包含这一事实的推广的优雅而高深的证明，但据我所知，只有一处能找到纯初等的证明[18]。第二个缺点是：任何计划以集合论研究为业的学生，无论如何都还得学习ZFC，因为几乎所有研究层次的集合论，都是采用逐层迭代隶属关系的集合观来进行的。这是目前的现实，并不是说集合论非得这样做不可。

The disadvantages are perhaps only temporary. There is at present a lack of teaching materials (the book [5] being the main exception). For example, the axioms imply that any two sets have a disjoint union, and most books on topos theory contain an elegant and sophisticated proof of a generalization of this fact, but to my knowledge, there is only one place where a purely elementary proof can be found [18]. A second disadvantage is that any student planning a career in set theory will need to learn ZFC anyway, since almost all research-level set theory is done with the iterated-membership conception of set. (That is the current reality, which is not to say that set theory must be done this way.)

对一场地震的反应Reactions to an earthquake

也许你明天醒来，查看电子邮件，就会看到一则公告：ZFC不相容。显然，有人从ZFC公理出发，经过一长串逻辑推演，得出了矛盾。有关工作已经反复核查，不再有任何疑问。

Perhaps you will wake up tomorrow, check your email, and find an announcement that ZFC is inconsistent. Apparently, someone has taken the ZFC axioms, performed a long string of logical deductions, and arrived at a contradiction. The work has been checked and re-checked. There is no longer any doubt.

你会作何反应？尤其是，对这件事给自己工作带来的影响，你会有什么感受？你的所有定理在ZFC之下仍然为真，但它们的否定也同样为真。你会认定自己毕生的工作都被毁掉了吗？

How would you react? In particular, how would you feel about the implications for your own work? All your theorems would still be true under ZFC, but so too would their negations. Would you conclude that your life’s work had been destroyed?

我相信，我们大多数人会感兴趣，却不会深感困扰。我们仍会相信：在某种意义下，我们的定理是真的，而它们的否定不是。对于那些我们本来就从未诉诸的公理，其不相容性不大可能让我们感到受威胁。

I believe that most of us would be interested but not deeply troubled. We would go on believing that our theorems were true in a sense that their negations were not. We are unlikely to feel threatened by the inconsistency of axioms to which we never referred anyway.

相比之下，上述十条公理是如此核心的数学原则，以至于它们若不相容，将是毁灭性的。如果我们不能放心假定函数复合满足结合律，或者反复把函数f:X⟶Xf\colon X\longrightarrow X作用于元素a∈Xa\in X便会产生序列(fn​(a))(f^{n}(a))，那就真的遇上麻烦了。

In contrast, the ten axioms above are such core mathematical principles that an inconsistency in them would be devastating. If we cannot safely assume that composition of functions is associative, or that repeatedly applying a function f:X⟶Xf\colon X\longrightarrow X to an element a∈Xa\in X produces a sequence (fn​(a))(f^{n}(a)), we are really in trouble.

作为较弱的系统，这十条公理比ZFC更不容易出现不相容性。但强度问题并非本文的中心；况且，如果想要一个与ZFC等强的系统，只需加入前面说的第十一条公理即可。真正要传达的是：只要写下几条关于集合与函数的平常而无争议的陈述，我们就能得到一套反映日常数学中集合实际用法的公理化体系。

As the weaker system, the ten axioms are less likely to be inconsistent than ZFC. But the question of strength is peripheral to this article (and in any case, if one wants a system of equal strength to ZFC, all one needs to do is add the aforementioned eleventh axiom). The real message is this: simply by writing down a few mundane, uncontroversial statements about sets and functions, we arrive at an axiomatization that reflects how sets are used in everyday mathematics.
